user.title: How does your Planetpod connect?
user.description:
Cloud: connects through PlanetPod's cloud service. Works out of the box, requires an internet connection.

Local: connects directly to your battery over your home network. Useful to run your own algorithms and automations against it.

cloud.title: Connect to Planetpod
cloud.description: Enter your Planetpod Open API credentials. Request a token in the Planetpod app under Instellingen → Integratie → Home Assistant Cloud → Aanvragen.

local_connect.title: Connect your Planetpod
local_connect.description:
Your Planetpod connects to this Home Assistant by itself, at `http://homeassistant.local:8123`. This address is fixed and can't be changed.

Before it can connect:
1. In the Planetpod app, go to **Instellingen → Batterijmodus → Open → Home Assistant**, and press **Verbinden** on **Home Assistant Lokaal**.
2. Home Assistant must be reachable at `http://homeassistant.local:8123` from the network your Planetpod is on. This works by default with Home Assistant OS.

⏳ **Waiting for your Planetpod…** This usually takes about 10 seconds after both are ready. Press **Submit** to check again.

Still waiting? See [Connection troubleshooting](https://github.com/Planetpod/home-assistant-planetpod#connection-troubleshooting).
